headline: NEW PRICES AT PUMPS: Here Is How Much You Need to Pay per Liter of Diesel and Gasoline
summary: From 15:00 on the day of the announcement, Euro diesel in Serbia will cost a maximum of 227 dinars per liter and Euro-premium BMB gasoline 202 dinars per liter, for the next seven days.
why: Serbia sets maximum retail fuel prices on a weekly basis, so changes pass through to transport costs, inflation and consumer spending.
